program_name: Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Occupational Therapy

requirements.general_text: Matriculation/Foundation/Pre-university/STPM Pass with minimum CGPA of 2.33 in any two (2) of the following subjects: Biology, Physics/Mathematics or Chemistry UEC Pass with minimum of 5B’s, two (2) of which include Biology & Physics/Mathematics A-level Pass with minimum Grade D in two (2) of the following subjects; Biology, Physics/Mathematics or Chemistry Diploma Recognised Diploma with minimum CGPA of 2.75 in a related field; OR Recognised Diploma with minimum CGPA less than 2.75 in a related field and a minimum of 3 years (36 months) working experience in the related field. English Language Requirements Local Student MUET score of minimum band 3 International Students IELTS score of at least 5.5/TOEFL (550) paper-based or equivalent
